name: Proposal — Documentos Tab
description: Admin views the 'Documentos' tab on the proposal edit page. Tab is visible for proposals in sent|viewed|negotiating|accepted|rejected status. Shows a unified document list (Contrato de desarrollo, Propuesta comercial PDF, Detalle técnico PDF) plus a 'Documentos adjuntos' section with upload form. Does NOT show 'Enviar documentos al cliente' (that section was removed Apr 22 2026 — sending is done from the Correos tab).
